author: reek
body: Probe: the network intrinsics carry Network.Read and Network.Write effect rows, so a function with a pure signature cannot reach the NIC. Until 2026-07-13 all four were typed pure and gated by nothing at all -- a program put raw Ethernet frames on the wire while declaring no effect and earning no capability, and neither the type checker nor the kernel had a word to say about it.

author: reek
body: In an application quire the effect is now enforced: the effectful mention cannot hide in a plain let (CDX2033), and net-status's effect is not declared in the signature (CDX2031). The owned hardware stack is quire-exempt; Ne2k is the sanctioned exempt caller, and it declares its rows anyway so that the code above it must too.
